entities.name: Zheng He's Treasure Ships
entities.label: Text
entities.summary: The massive wooden ships (up to 120 meters long) of Admiral Zheng He's seven maritime expeditions (1405-1433) under the Ming dynasty, the largest wooden vessels ever built. These treasure fleets — carrying up to 28,000 crew — projected Chinese power across Southeast Asia, India, Arabia, and East Africa, representing the peak of pre-modern maritime technology.
